labels.selection_reason: Chest-centered one-hand circular motion; grossly different from table/hat/family head signs and already present in the PopSign 5-label diagnostic ladder.
Two-hand horizontal signing-space structure; visually separated from single-hand chest and head-contact signs and strongest retained PopSign ladder score.
Single-hand forehead contact; intentionally exercises the head crop while remaining distinguishable from table and please.
Head-origin movement with outward temporal arc; keeps a related-family contrast in the smoke so the proof cannot pass only on broad body location.
Headwear placement silhouette; stresses the optional head region and provides a different hand configuration than dad/grandpa.

selected_tier0.known_confusion_risk: dad, grandpa, and hat all use the upper/head region. This is deliberate for a small proof with a head crop; if M3AE shows head-region confusion, the remediation path is to adjust crops or replace one head-region label before expanding.

selection_basis.method: Use the existing 5-label PopSign diagnostic ladder as the smallest approved-source seed, then bind source/crop/gate evidence before any new decode or training.
selection_basis.diagnostic_ladder_note: The prior ladder ranked labels by retained broad-run validation/test recall and F1. This artifact does not promote that broad run; it only uses the ladder to choose a small source-reviewed candidate set.

restrictions: must cite and attribute PopSign ASL v1.0 under CC BY 4.0
only original game-category raw video archives may be imported
preview videos and derived pose, landmark, embedding, detector, feature, or pretrained artifacts are disallowed
source train, validation, and test split boundaries must be preserved
source signer identifiers must remain pseudonymous in ASL Pilot manifests

existing_seed_manifests.note: These diagnostic manifests establish source coverage only. M3AD must generate or refresh Tier 0 manifests/tensors with the committed crop_config_hash before training.

split_limitations: The proof preserves PopSign source train/validation/test boundaries rather than reassigning clips.
The test split has 19 clips per selected label, while train and validation have 25 per selected label.
The selected labels come from approved external PopSign game videos, not first-party learner webcam recordings.
This is a learnability proof only; it is not final product validation or a final-promotion hard-negative gate.

phonology_status.note: SemLex / ASL-LEX phonology remains outside this source decision until source-register evidence and overlap artifacts are written.

next_milestone: M3AD decode and dataloader proof with crop-config hash binding before training.
